common.tagline: Built for responsible blood donation coordination.

hero.title: Every connection can
hero.subtitle: Discover blood donation resources and connect with participating donors and verified organizations across India.
hero.noticeText: RaktDal is a coordination platform. Availability and medical suitability must always be confirmed by qualified professionals.

howItWorks.heading: Making Blood Donation Connections Easier
howItWorks.subtitle: A transparent, volunteer-driven coordination flow designed for patients, donors, and healthcare centers.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Search opted-in voluntary donors by blood group, city, or PIN code with granular privacy controls.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Post urgent or scheduled blood requirements with hospital details and verified medical contacts.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Register your blood type, set your availability schedule, and choose your preferred contact methods.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Coordinate community blood drives, partner with recognized blood banks, and notify nearby donors.

explore.heading: One Platform. Multiple Ways to Help.
explore.subtitle: Designed to support every participant in the voluntary healthcare ecosystem.
explore.card1Desc: Filter donors by verified blood groups, geographic location, and real-time availability status.
explore.card2Desc: Browse active patient needs across verified clinics, medical colleges, and regional hospitals.
explore.card3Desc: Directory of licensed regional blood centers and storage banks across participating states.
explore.card4Desc: Find upcoming voluntary donation camps organized by authorized community and hospital partners.

cta.heading: Be Someone's Reason to Smile.
cta.subtitle: Your willingness to help can make a meaningful difference. Join RaktDal and support responsible blood donation coordination.

footer.aboutText: Connecting people, donors, and verified organizations for responsible blood donation coordination across India.
footer.disclaimerNotice: Medical Disclaimer: RaktDal facilitates coordination and does not independently verify real-time blood availability or determine medical suitability. Blood transfusion compatibility and recipient eligibility must strictly be confirmed by authorized medical professionals and certified blood bank staff.
footer.tagline: Built for responsible blood donation coordination.

pages.bloodBanksDesc: Directory listings for authorized regional blood banks and storage facilities across India. Real-time API integration with national portal coming soon.
pages.campsDesc: Scheduled public donation drives organized by colleges, hospitals, and verified community partners across India.
pages.aboutDesc: RaktDal is a Pan-India blood donor coordination and emergency request platform built to streamline the voluntary blood donation network with strict privacy controls.
pages.howItWorksDesc: RaktDal connects donors and healthcare coordinators using verified profiles, location-indexed discovery, and direct request-response communication.
pages.contactDesc: For technical assistance, organization onboarding, or general queries, please reach out to our platform support team.
pages.privacyDesc: RaktDal strictly protects donor personal data. Phone numbers, emails, and last donation history are never revealed without explicit donor consent.
pages.termsDesc: RaktDal is a voluntary coordination platform. Users agree to provide truthful information and adhere to responsible community standards.
pages.disclaimerDesc: RaktDal is a coordination platform. Availability and medical suitability must always be confirmed by qualified medical professionals. RaktDal does not verify blood suitability.
pages.helpDesc: Frequently asked questions, donor guides, and instructions for posting emergency blood requests.
